art_source.method: existing portrait only; no generated image is used in the pack

art_source.edits: eye artwork cleared and repainted per emotion, plus small effects, strictly within the 12 colours of the published portrait

background_provenance.template_grid: 5 columns x 8 rows, 40px cells; top 5x4 normal source, exact-flip mirror output
background_provenance.requantised_cells: only template cells whose colour count exceeds 15, deterministic and dither-free
